purpose: Verify compiled plans account for every decomposed goal clause and fail closed on silent omissions.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/goal_compiler.py')
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('gc',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
reg=json.loads(pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.json').read_text())['capabilities']
goal=json.loads(pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/missions/ASTRA_RUNTIME_FANOUT_XLSX_JOIN_004.json').read_text())['goal']
out=m.compile_goal(goal,reg,pathlib.Path('.').resolve())
assert out.get('clause_coverage_verified') is True,out
clauses=out.get('clauses') or []
parts=out.get('compiled_parts') or []
assert sorted(p['index'] for p in parts)==list(range(len(clauses))),(clauses,parts)
bad=dict(out); bad['compiled_parts']=[p for p in parts if p['index']!=5]
try:
    m._validate_compiled_clause_coverage(bad)
except m.GoalCompilationFailure as exc:
    assert exc.code=='COMPILED_CLAUSE_COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE',exc
else:
    raise AssertionError('MISSING_CLAUSE_WAS_ACCEPTED')
print('COMPILED_CLAUSE_COVERAGE_VERIFIED')
PY
